title: Man charged with murdering father in Lawrence
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Crime Elvin Joaquin Rodriguez, 26, pleaded not guilty to charges of murder, carrying a loaded firearm without a license, and discharging a firearm within 500 feet of a building.
A man was charged with murdering his father in Lawrence on Tuesday.

Elvin Joaquin Rodriguez, 26, pleaded not guilty to the charges of murder, carrying a loaded firearm without a license, and discharging a firearm within 500 feet of a building in Lawrence District Court, according to the Essex County District Attorney’s Office.
